title: Savings & Money Market Accounts: paper statement and wire fees by tier
content:
## Scope

This quick reference lists, for each tier of Savings & Money Market Accounts, the paper statement fee with its age exemption and the two wire fees.

## Definitions

- **Paper statement fee**: the fee per statement cycle when the account's statement delivery is paper at cycle close, in USD.
- **Paper statement exemption age**: owners who are at least this age, in whole years, at cycle close pay no paper statement fee.
- **Outgoing domestic wire fee**: the fee per outgoing domestic wire sent from the account, in USD.
- **Incoming wire fee**: the fee per incoming wire credited to the account, in USD.

## Tier table

| Tier | Paper statement fee | Paper statement exemption age | Outgoing domestic wire fee | Incoming wire fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter Savings | USD 0.00 | 65 | USD 30.00 | USD 15.00 |
| Statement Savings | USD 2.00 | 65 | USD 30.00 | USD 15.00 |
| Goal Builder Savings | USD 0.00 | 65 | USD 30.00 | USD 15.00 |
| Money Market Account | USD 2.00 | 65 | USD 30.00 | USD 15.00 |
| Premier Money Market | USD 0.00 | 65 | USD 20.00 | USD 0.00 |
| Private Client Money Market | USD 0.00 | 65 | USD 10.00 | USD 0.00 |

## Reading the table

- Only Statement Savings and Money Market Account carry a paper statement fee above zero (USD 2.00 each); on the other four tiers the paper statement fee is USD 0.00.
- The exemption age is 65 on every tier: an owner aged 65 or older at cycle close is exempt; an owner aged 64 at cycle close is not.
- The outgoing domestic wire fee is USD 30.00 on the first four tiers, USD 20.00 on Premier Money Market and USD 10.00 on Private Client Money Market.
- Premier Money Market and Private Client Money Market charge USD 0.00 for incoming wires; the other tiers charge USD 15.00.

## Points of judgement

**A Statement Savings owner who is 70 years old at cycle close receives paper statements. What paper statement fee applies?** None; the owner is at least 65 at cycle close.

**A Money Market Account owner who is 40 years old at cycle close receives paper statements. What fee applies?** The tier's paper statement fee of USD 2.00 for that cycle.
